newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Energy desulphuriser to be completed Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Japan Energy desulphuriser to be completed Feb 24.

text.p: Japan Energy Corp said on Thursday it would finish building a 40,000 barrel-per-day advanced gas oil desulphuriser on February 24.

With the new desulphuriser, all of the firm's refineries will be equipped with facilities which can lower the sulphur content of gas oil to less than 0.05 percent, a spokeswoman said. The cost of the desulphuriser and its facilities is 6.5 billion yen, she said.
The government plans to implement stricter environmental standards on gas oil in October, aiming to cut the maximum allowable sulphur content to 0.05 percent from 0.2 percent.
